usage.title: Usage
usage.description: Below are described methods of installation on various platforms.

iphone.title: iPhone
iphone.description: Download the <0>v2RayTun</0> Application. Then copy the config and add it to the application. Click the + in the top right corner, then <1>Add from clipboard → Allow paste → Connect.</1>

android.title: Android
android.description: Download the <0>Hiddify</0> application (VPN is required for downloading). Then copy the config and add it to the application. <1>New profile → Add from clipboard → Connect</1>.

windows.title: Windows
windows.description:
The <1>Hiddify</1> application needs to be run with administrator rights. Therefore, it is recommended to download it from the official <0>GitHub</0> page. You need to open the <1>Assets</1> section and download the appropriate version for you. In our case, it is <1>Hiddify-Windows-Setup-x64.exe</1>. It is also recommended to choose a release with the label <2>Latest</2>.
Or download from the <3>Microsoft Store</3>.
windows.settingsDescription:
If you downloaded the application from <0>GitHub</0>, you have the option to configure auto-start with administrator rights. To do this, right-click the shortcut and go to <1>Properties → Compatibility → Run as administrator → Apply</1>.
After launching the application, add the config by copying it prematurely. <1>Click the + icon in the top right corner → Add from clipboard.</1> Then select the settings icon in the top right corner. In the appearing menu, change from <0>Proxy</0> to <0>VPN</0>. Now you can connect!

linux.title: Linux
linux.description: Similar to connecting on <0>Windows</0>, but instead of <0>.exe</0>, choose <0>Hiddify-Linux-x64.AppImage</0>.
